## Change

Describe the need, bounded change, and nearest competing capability.

## Evidence

- [ ] `npm run ci`
- [ ] Routing and task-completion evidence are reported separately
- [ ] New behavior has positive, negative, and ambiguous cases
- [ ] Localized behavior is covered when applicable

## Safety and provenance

- [ ] Generated Skill projections were not edited directly
- [ ] Permission changes are declared and approved
- [ ] Protected datasets were not used for proposal generation
- [ ] Upstream attribution and license state are preserved
- [ ] A rollback revision is supplied for governed evolution
